Name: Fishing Progression 1.6
Author: chadlymasterson
Description:
A small and modular fishing progression mod with the aim to be easily configurable. This mod aims to make you feel like you're becoming a better angler as you level up.

The mod currently adds small passive buffs to fishing via reducing difficulty, chances to not reduce tackle durability, and chance to double hook both fish and trash.

[u][size=4]Features[/size][/u]
[list]
[*]Difficulty reduction scaled by level
[*]Tackle durability restoration chance scaled by level
[*]Double hook chance scaled by level
[*]Auto hook fish unlocked at level milestone
[*]Auto treasure chests unlocked at level milestone
[*]Bite time reduction (* wip)
[/list][size=4][u]Planned Features[/u][/size][list]
[*]Upgradable tackle box that will automatically refill the tackle / bait in your fishing rod (Will likely require 1.6)
[/list]
if you have any suggestions for future features feel free to drop them in the posts![u][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/u]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] - All config options are configurable using the mod menu.

[u][size=4]Installation[/size][/u]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI
[*]Download this mod
[*]Extract this mod's .zip file in the Mods folder
[/list][u][size=4]Notes:[/size]
[/u]To make some features of this mod work, there can be some incompatibilities with other mods that make changes to the game code for fishing.
I have not been able to test all mods so please, if you find a bug, errors, or breaking issues, please report them to the github below.

[url=https://github.com/chudders1231/SDV-FishingProgression]Github Source Code[/url]
